──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n398\t// Command handlers\n399\t// ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n400\t\n401\t/// `needle run` — launch a worker.\n402\t///\n403\t/// Always creates dedicated tmux sessions for workers,   // load state from heartbeat file + registry, continue from SELECTING.\n444\t        let worker_id = identifier\n445\t            .clone()\n446\t            .unwrap_or_else(|| NATO_ALPHABET[0].to_string());\n447\t\n448\t        // Load resume state from heartbeat and registry.\n449\t        let resume_state = crate::upgrade::ResumeState::load(&config, sanitize_session_name(&format!(\"needle-{agent_name}-{worker_id}\"));\n496\t        tracing::info!(worker = %worker_id, session = %session_name, \"starting worker (inner re-entrant startup delays.\n507\tfn launch_workers(\n508\t    config: Config,\n509\t    workspace: Option<PathBuf>,\n510\t    agent: Option<String>,\n511\t    count: u32,\n512\t    identifier: tracing::warn!(\n593\t                    worker_id = %name,\n594\t                    \"skipping occupied worker name\"\n595\t                );\n596\t                continue;\n597\t            }\n598\t            ids.push(name.to_string());\n599\t        }\n600\t        if ids.len() < effective_count as usize {\n601\t            bail!(\n602\t                \"cannot launch {} workers — only ids\n609\t    };\n610\t\n611\t    for (seq, worker_id) in worker_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n612\t        let session_name = needle-{sanitized_agent}-{worker_id}\");\n653\t    }\n654\t\n655\t    Ok(())\n656\t}\n657\t\n658\t/// Initialize the tracing subscriber with OTLP layer if configured.\n659\t///\n660\t/// This must be     );\n713\t        }\n714\t    });\n715\t\n716\t    // Build exporters and tracer provider based on protocol\n717\t    let (tracer_provider, ..) = match otlp_config.protocol.as_str() {\n718\t Uses the telemetry module's session ID generator.\n784\tfn generate_session_id_for_worker() -> String {\n785\t    crate::telemetry::generate_session_id()\n786\t}\n787\t\n788\t/// Start the worker worker_name: String) -> Result<()> {\n795\t    let boot_start = Instant::now();\n796\t    let qualified_id = format!(\"{}-{}\", config.agent.default, worker_name);\n797\t\n798\t    // Phase 0: create %result, \"worker finished\");\n869\t    Ok(())\n870\t}\n871\t\n872\t/// Emit start/complete telemetry around a fallible initialization step.\n873\t///\n874\t/// Each step's completion is .filter_map(|item| {\n248\t                if item.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n249\t                    item.get(\"text\").and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n250\t   }\n1195\t    }\n1196\t}\n1197\t\n1198\t/// Validate an agent adapter: check CLI availability, version, and probe.\n1199\tpub fn test_agent(adapter_name: &str, config: &Config) ->        .with_context(|| format!(\"unknown adapter: {adapter_name}\"))?;\n1205\t\n1206\t    let mut errors = Vec::new();\n1207\t\n1208\t    // 1. Find the CLI binary on PATH.\n1209\t    let cli_path = match which::which(&adapter.agent_cli) {\n1210\t        Ok(path) => Some(path.display().to_string()),\n1211\t        Err(_) => {\n1212\t            errors.push(format!(\"CLI '{}' not found on PATH\", adapter.agent_cli));\n1213\t            None\n1214\t        }\n1215\t    };\n1216\t\n1217\t    // 2.
